name: IBY_TRANSACTION_ERRORS
description: IBY_TRANSACTION_ERRORS stores any errors encountered during payment processing validations.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ERROR_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction type. Values from the lookup IBY_TRANSACTION_TYPES include DOCUMENT_PAYABLE, PAYMENT, and PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction Identifier

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code for failed transaction. If ERROR_TYPE is BANK, this is a bank-specific error code.

columns.name: ERROR_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the error occurred

columns.name: ORIGINATOR_CODE
columns.description: Status reason code sent from bank or payment systems

columns.name: ORIGINATOR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Status reason message sent from bank or payment systems

columns.name: ERROR_STATUS
columns.description: Whether the error is still active, that is, the error still applies, passed, or overridden. Values from the lookup IBY_TRANSACTION_ERROR_STATUSES include ACTIVE, PASSED, and OVERRIDDEN. The last two values only apply to validation errors.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_ALLOWED_ON_ERROR_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag specifying whether this validation error can be overridden by the payment administrator. Some validation errors are fatal and the condition causing the error must be corrected so the payment instruction can be validated successfully. By default, this flag is Y. For fatal errors, the Create Payment Instructions program sets this flag to N.

columns.name: DO_NOT_APPLY_ERROR_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag which only applies to errors on payment instructions. The value is N by default and only changes to Y if an administrator overrides the error. When a payment instruction is resubmitted to the Create Payment Instructions program and validations are applied, this error is not applied when the value is Y.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CALLING_APP_ID
columns.description: Source product Identifier

columns.name: PAY_PROC_TRXN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment processing transaction type striped by application

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF1
columns.description: Source product''s first unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF2
columns.description: Source product''s second unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF3
columns.description: Source product''s third unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF4
columns.description: Source product''s fourth unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF5
columns.description: Source product''s fifth unique document payable Identifier

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Type of error. Values from the lookup IBY_TRANSACTION_ERROR_TYPES include VALIDATION and BANK.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message for failed transaction. If ERROR_TYPE is BANK, this is a bank-specific error code.

columns.name: VALIDATION_SET_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the validation set that was violated if ERROR_TYPE is VALIDATION.

columns.name: PASS_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the validation set that gave rise to this error was passed. This column is not be populated if the DO_NOT_APPLY_ERROR_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Justification for overriding validation error. This column is only populated if the DO_NOT_APPLY_ERROR_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the error was overridden. This column is only populated if the DO_NOT_APPLY_ERROR_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: STATUS_ORGINATOR_ID
columns.description: ID of the status originator.

columns.name: STATUS_ORIGINATOR_ID_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the status originator ID. I.e., BIC, CHIPS, ABA Routing number, ISO20022 clearing system member ID, etc.

columns.name: STATUS_ORGINATOR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the status originator - a financial institution on the payment chain that initated the status such as rejection

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TOKEN_REQUEST_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Message format for creating outbound request to launch hosted payment page owned by payment gateway to create credit card token.

columns.name: TOKEN_RESPONSE_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Message format for reading and processing inbound response received from payment gateway for credit card token creation using hosted payment page.

columns.name: TOKEN_REQUEST_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error raised while initiating outbound request for credit card token creation.

columns.name: TOKEN_RESPONSE_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error raised while reading and processing inbound response received from payment gateway for token creation request.

columns.name: QUERY_REQUEST_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Message format for creating outbound request to query the payment gateway.

columns.name: QUERY_RESPONSE_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Message format for reading and processing inbound response received from payment gateway for transaction query.

columns.name: QUERY_REQUEST_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error raised while initiating outbound request to query the payment gateway.

columns.name: QUERY_RESPONSE_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error raised while reading and processing inbound response received from payment gateway for payment query.

columns.name: OAUTH_PERFORMED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction supports Oauth.

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: The payment system identifier that will issue the payment instrument token.

columns.name: BEP_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account that contains the merchant identifier parameters of the payment system that will issue the payment instrument token.

columns.name: USER_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Funds capture process profile code related to payment instrument token.
